scope: Proposition 4.5 (Exact simple-family cancellation) of the manuscript “The Boltzmann–Grad limit for stable radial potentials on regular kinetic intervals” (preprints/The-Boltzmann-Grad-limit-for-stable-radial-potentials-on-regular-kinetic-intervals-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 364 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dce9fe5976f17b89), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the retained operator Aj of (4.19), a singleton root whose displayed family satisfies the reference-history conditions Sε,J n above, ends entirely on independent f(tj−1), and avoids every displayed trajectory of every other family throughout the layer cancels with its tensor-subtraction term. The avoidance requirement includes all detached generation groups and all reference trees coming from tensor subtraction. It also includes the full-array pattern restrictions at cuts. A residual factor is treated as a stopped slot, not as an unexamined trajectory. The pairing is exact coefficientwise for total formal size p < Kj. The finite complementary operator Bj stays in (4.21); no cancellation or positive physical remainder bound is asserted for it.
